speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
text: asked the Minister for Education whether Chinese dialects can be introduced as an elective as part of the (i) current conversational Chinese enrichment programme for students in primary and secondary schools and (ii) modular foreign languages programme pilot at the secondary level.

speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
text: Just one supplementary question for the Minister of State.

speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
text: I do recognise that quite a number of the clan associations do conduct such classes to help to promote certain dialects for their respective dialect groups.

speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
text: But at the same time, just over the weekend, I had the pleasure, alongside other Members, of attending a certain dialect group's dinner, where quite a few actually lamented that the younger generation, right now, cannot speak the dialect at all.
